description: Jamal fake-host scenarios (JOB-10): whole-verb deploy, rollback, lock, and interruption scenarios of packages/jamal/test/scenarios that today's release engine fails against the FakeHost model (packages/jamal/src/testing). Each entry records one defect of the current engine; fixedBy names the deploy package whose engine passes the scenario (JOB-13 release execution and retention); the secrets-file scenarios JOB-11 fixed and the host-state, lock, and digest scenarios JOB-12 fixed left with them. JOB-13 empties and deletes this ledger.

test: consecutive deploys keep at most retain + 1 (6) app images

failure.message: the host keeps 8 app images after 8 deploys; at most 6 are allowed
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Unbounded images: a deploy removes the previous container but never an image, so every release's image stays on the server until the disk fills.

test: an interrupt at any remote command leaves one serving release and no lock

failure.message: an interrupt left the host wrong at
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: An interrupt releases the lock but leaves a release container that started and never took traffic running (the plan retires leftovers only on the next deploy), and a signal that arrives after the handlers are detached but before the final lock release ends the process with the lock held.
